items.title: NHL.com prints two different Ottawa records
items.what: The 22 October scores page shows Ottawa as 6-3-0; the 21 October standings page shows 7-3-0 over 10 games. The standings figure is used, and the row is marked medium.

items.title: Los Angeles and Calgary goals-for / goals-against not published
items.what: Both NHL pages read during this session give the Kings and Flames a win-loss-overtime record but no goals for/against, so the goals-based markets on NHL-20261022-06 and -09 are blank and those two moneyline prices use the disclosed points-percentage fallback.

items.title: Rugby League World Cup kick-off times carry no timezone
items.what: The official draw prints 5:05 AM, 2:35 AM, 12:25 AM, 1:05 AM and 5:05 AM with no zone. The times are reproduced verbatim with that caveat; no conversion has been applied.

items.title: Model rates Fiji above Australia on one match
items.what: Fiji beat the Cook Islands 40-12 and Australia beat New Zealand by two, so the single-match rating favours Fiji by 0.81. The desk does not publish that as a High-confidence pick: the row is held at Medium and listed here for manual review.

items.title: NBA venues not published on the games page
items.what: The NBA games page for 22 October lists both fixtures, tip-off times and records but no arena, so the venue field is blank on NBA-20261022-01 and -02.

items.title: Opening-week NBA games cannot be priced on form
items.what: Neither club has a verified current-season record beyond one game, so both NBA rows use the home-court prior, are graded Low, and carry no spread or total.

items.title: Rugby union and rugby league totals not originated
items.what: One verified match per club does not establish a scoring level, so match totals are blank on all 13 rugby rows; the handicap is originated because it is a relative measure from the same rating and is labelled as such.

items.title: Thirteen in-scope sports have no verified fixture in this cycle
items.what: Tennis, cricket, darts, handball, snooker, badminton, table tennis, volleyball, golf, motor racing, greyhound racing, Aussie Rules and esports are listed on the coverage page with the official URL that was tried and the reason no row was published. They are gaps, not empty sports.

items.title: High picks quote at the -250 floor
items.what: The brief asks for High picks between -250 and +10,000. Our model gives several selections more than 71.4% (a shorter fair price than -250), so the desk quotes them at its -250 floor and marks every capped row. The fair price is shown on the row.
